question.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 2 \\ b & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+4{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$
question.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & ={x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+4{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2} \\  & =1{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+2{x}_{1}{y}_{2} \\  & +\,4{x}_{2}{y}_{1}\,+1{x}_{2}{y}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=1$ and $b=4.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b=1+4=5.
$$
